{{Locations|Engi Controlled Sector|Engi Homeworlds|distress=true|LRSmap=ship|unique=true}}


''The distress signal originates at a small Engi ship under attack by a rebel fighter - but when they see Federation markings they turn to attack!''
* Fight the [[Rebel Ships|Rebel Ship]]. <ref name="Enemy ship (DISTRESS_ENGI_REBEL)">{{SurrenderEscape(alt)|no|DISTRESS_ENGI_REBEL|events_ships.xml}}</ref>
** {{Winning|destroyed=true|The rebels destroyed, you pick the bones of their ship and wait for the small Engi ship to catch up.}}
*** You receive low [[Rewards#Standard|scrap with resources]].
**** [[#After the fight|'''After the fight''']].
** {{Winning|deadCrew=true|The rebels destroyed, you pick the bones of their ship and wait for the small Engi ship to catch up.}}
*** You receive medium [[Rewards#Standard|scrap with resources]].
**** [[#After the fight|'''After the fight''']].

==After the fight==
''The Engi vessel turns out to be very poorly equipped - barely a runabout, really. They're trying to outrun the rebels, and need all the help they can get.''
